findings.problem: The ABS caution on p62 and its mandatory display ('Do not run the motorcycle if the ABS indicator lamp stays continuously ON') are unconditional, and the same component's NOTE says all tell-tales switch OFF after engine start. The manual's next page qualifies the same lamp: it stays ON at start-up until 5 km/h, and the caution applies only when it is ON continuously ABOVE 5 km/h. Those qualifiers (already V4 admitted) are not linked to this component, so a rider whose ABS lamp is lit at start-up could be told not to ride, or be told all tell-tales should already be off.
findings.evidence_from_page: PDF p63 (printed 61) ABS INDICATOR LAMP: 'the ABS sign will glow and remain ON till the motorcycle attains a speed of 5 km/h and turns OFF...'; CAUTION: 'Do not run motorcycle in case the ABS indicator lamp is ON continuously above 5 km/h.' (PDF p66 repeats the 5 kmph start-up behaviour.)
